additional_info.body:
Dear Clément Thieffry,
Following your request and after reviewing the logs, we identified that the SCB of two chargers (M0iV2v and fVAISr) are out of order. Unfortunately, the logs for these chargers are not accessible, which prevents us from determining the root cause of the issue.
For the other chargers, after checking the logs, we are unable to identify the issue based on the information provided. We kindly ask you to provide the correct timestamps for each charger so that we can continue reviewing the logs and work toward resolving the problem.
Should you require any additional information or assistance in the meantime, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Kind regards,
Anass Mezzaoui
eMobility Technical Support Team
